usage.setbank: Usage: /setbank <bank> <account number> <account name> Example: /setbank MBBank 0123456789 NGUYEN VAN A Use the bank short name SePay knows, e.g. MBBank, Vietcombank, Techcombank, ACB, VPBank, TPBank, BIDV, VietinBank.

sepay.info: 🔌 Connect SePay 1. In my.sepay.vn open Tích hợp WebHooks and add a webhook. 2. Event: Có tiền vào (incoming money), for the team bank account. 3. URL: {url} 4. Authentication: API Key, using the key from the button below. 5. Content type: application/json. {status}
sepay.connected: Status: an API key is set.
sepay.key: 🔑 New SePay API key (shown only once; any old key stops working): {key}
sepay.ask_token: 🔌 Connect SePay I'll create the payment webhook in your SePay account for you. I need a SePay API token once: 1. Open my.sepay.vn → Cấu hình công ty → API Access. 2. Tap + Thêm API, name it e.g. Team Fund, and copy the token. 3. Send it here: /sepaytoken YOUR_TOKEN (or reply to this message with the token). I delete your message right away and keep the token encrypted. The team's bank account must already be linked in SePay.
sepay.token_saved: ✅ SePay token saved ({n} bank account(s) found). Setting up the webhook…

m.welcome: 👋 Team Fund gives your team its own Telegram bot that collects the monthly fee and confirms payments automatically through SePay. How to start 1. Send /requestteam and wait for approval. 2. Create a bot in @BotFather with /newbot and copy its token. 3. Send /newteam here and paste the token. /myteams Your teams /lang Language

m.ask_token: Paste the bot token from @BotFather. It looks like 123456789:AAH...
m.bad_token: That doesn't look like a bot token. Copy it again from @BotFather.
m.token_rejected: Telegram did not accept that token. Check it in @BotFather and try again.
m.token_deleted: 🔒 I deleted your message with the token.
m.team_created: 🎉 {team} is ready: @{bot} Open @{bot} and: 1. /setbank Bank account for the QR code 2. /sepay Connect SePay 3. Add @{bot} to your team group and send /linkgroup there 4. /add members, then /setfee and /setdue
